title: Descent of normalized point blowups from completion
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local domain whose maximal-ideal-adic completion $\widehat A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Suppose a finite sequence $Z_n\to\cdots\to Z_0=\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$ consists of proper normalized blowups at closed points over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Here a normalized blowup is a blowup at the reduced closed point followed by normalization in the function field [def-nagata-global-blowup, def-sc-normalization]. There is a finite sequence of proper normalized blowups $X_n\to\cdots\to X_0=\operatorname{Spec}A$, with centers above its closed point, whose base change along $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is isomorphic to the given sequence, including its structure morphisms [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $Z_n$ is regular, then $X_n$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Length zero is allowed.

source.place: Tags 0BGA (resolve-lemma-normalized-blowup-completion) and 0BG6(3) (resolve-lemma-port-regularity-to-completion), for the proper descended endpoint.

proof.text: Write $Y_i=Z_i$ for the given tower and $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$. Proceed by induction on $i$, with inductive claim: there are proper normalized blowups $X_i\to\cdots\to X_0=\operatorname{Spec}A$ with centres over the closed point and an isomorphism $X_i\times_A\widehat A\cong Y_i$ compatible with the structure morphisms of both towers. The base $i=0$ is $\operatorname{Spec}A\times_A\widehat A=\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A=Y_0$; this is also the whole statement for length zero (the identity tower). For the induction step, $\widehat A$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\widehat A$ and $\kappa\cong\widehat A/\mathfrak m\widehat A$, so $Y_i\times_{\widehat A}\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A/\mathfrak m\widehat A)\cong X_i\times_A\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A/\mathfrak m\widehat A)\cong X_i\times_A\operatorname{Spec}\kappa$: the closed fibres of $Y_i$ and $X_i$ are isomorphic. The centre $y_i$ of the next normalized blowup is a closed point over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$, so it corresponds to a closed point $x_i$ of the closed fibre of $X_i$; the closed fibre is closed in $X_i$, hence $x_i$ is a closed point of $X_i$ over the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $\kappa(x_i)\cong\kappa(y_i)$ is a $\kappa$-algebra.

source.place: Tag 0BGA proof, induction setup and correspondence of closed points in the special fibres.

proof.text: Let $X_i^{\prime}\to X_i$ be the ordinary blowup at the reduced point $x_i$, with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I$. The completion map $A\to\widehat A$ is flat, and flatness is preserved by base change, so $g:Y_i=X_i\times_A\widehat A\to X_i$ is flat. The closed subscheme $V(\mathcal I\mathcal O_{Y_i})=g^{-1}(x_i)=\operatorname{Spec}(\kappa(x_i)\otimes_A\widehat A)=\operatorname{Spec}(\kappa(x_i)\otimes_\kappa\widehat A/\mathfrak m\widehat A)=\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x_i)$ is the reduced point $y_i$, by the identification of closed fibres in Step 1. So the flat blowup base-change comparison identifies $X_i^{\prime}\times_A\widehat A$, over $Y_i$, with the ordinary blowup $Y_i^{\prime}$ of $Y_i$ at $y_i$.

source.place: Tag 0BGA proof, paragraph beginning “Let $X_i^{\prime}\to X_i$ be the blowup”; flat blowup base change is Tag 0805.

proof.text: $X_i$ is of finite type over the Noetherian ring $A$, hence locally Noetherian, so the ideal sheaf of the closed point $x_i$ is of finite type and the ordinary blowup $X_i^{\prime}\to X_i$ is proper; in particular $X_i^{\prime}$ is of finite type over $A$. The normalization $X_{i+1}\to X_i^{\prime}$ supplied by the comparison node is finite, hence proper, and the composite of these two proper maps is proper. Therefore every descended arrow $X_{i+1}\to X_i$ is a proper normalized blowup; its centre $x_i$ lies over the closed point by Step 1.

source.place: Tag 0BGA statement and proof, with properness of blowups and finiteness of normalization.

proof.text: Assume the endpoint $Z_n=Y_n$ is regular. The completion map $A\to\widehat A$ is faithfully flat, so $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is flat and surjective, and its base change $Z_n\cong X_n\times_A\widehat A\to X_n$ is flat and surjective. For each point $x\in X_n$, choose a point $y\in Z_n$ over it. The induced local map $\mathcal O_{X_n,x}\to\mathcal O_{Z_n,y}$ is flat and local, hence faithfully flat. The ring $\mathcal O_{Z_n,y}$ is Noetherian and each of its localizations at a prime is the local ring of $Z_n$ at a generization of $y$, hence regular; so it is a regular ring, and regularity descends along the faithfully flat map: $\mathcal O_{X_n,x}$ is a regular (local) ring. Thus every local ring of the locally Noetherian scheme $X_n$ is regular, so $X_n$ is regular.

split_report.summary: Split the completion descent into the Stacks 0BGA induction on the tower length. The proof descends each closed-point centre through the common special fibre, uses flat base change for the ordinary blowup, applies the new Tag 0BG9 normalization-completion node, proves properness by finite normalization and composition, and descends endpoint regularity by faithful-flat local regularity descent. The item statement is unchanged and the length-zero case is explicit.

tool_uses.why: The ordinary blowup base-change comparison is a generic blowup tool from the Nagata compactification unit.
The fact that a blowup is an isomorphism off its centre is a generic blowup tool.
Properness of each ordinary blowup is a generic blowup tool.
Flatness of the adic completion is used to base-change the ordinary blowup.
Flatness survives the base change from A to the completion.
Faithful flatness of the completion supplies points above every point of the descended endpoint.
The localized flat local map of local rings is faithfully flat.
Regularity of the completed local ring descends through the faithfully flat local map.
Normality of the normalized stages Y_i (normalization in the generic point has integrally closed local rings) is a generic normalization tool; no node of the DLAFT unit gives it.
Surjectivity of the base change of Spec of the completion supplies points above every point, used for integrality of the descended blowup and for regularity descent.
